import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

String caption(int count) => count == 1 ? '1 parcel' : '$count parcels';

class ParcelLabel extends StatelessWidget {
  const ParcelLabel(this.count, {super.key});

  final int count;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Directionality(
    textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
    child: Text(count > 9 ? 'many parcels' : caption(count)),
  );
}
